notes.title: Social Caterpillar - Wishlist the Next Twelve Tiles Game!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/334e3aacea671a035976b0d2ae0a60f231a39b43.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to formally announce [b]Social Caterpillar[/b], a puzzle adventure set within the framework of introversion and socialization.  Move through different dioramas, leashed only by your Social Energy. Interact with friends, family, and strangers in the form of abstracted conversational puzzles, each with its own discrete logic. The more you engage with Living Humans, the more Social Energy you'll gain to explore the world!  You can WISHLIST it here! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514940/Social_Caterpillar/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Some of you [url="https://www.twelvetiles.com/socialcaterpillar"]may recognize the game[/url]. This is an update and re-release of the original Social Caterpillar in a new engine. If you played the old version (or would still like to), that's okay! This is a total upgrade. You can expect: [/p][list][*][p] New puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]Double the locations[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of secrets to discover[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life changes[/p][/*][*][p]Updated graphics and music[/p][/*][*][p]A second layer of implicit narrative[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/047139a607a12f569d15e4b38499e009dcc6c6d6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/6a9bdd712fa12156bf83b9aa965eabbf3585ad06.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/30fb0757551d591762a649f1b6002a6fede494a6.png"][/img][/p][p]We can expect the game to release later this year. If you'd like more details, or think you'd be interested in some of the testing, [url="https://discord.com/invite/RDAyjaejDJ"]join us on our Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks, everyone, for the support![/p]

notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40507849/5b310b45ce3bdd2ee6790f6eff47df6e03be9396.png[/img]

[h2]Visual Novel Fest
[/h2]
Steam's weeklong Visual Novel Fest starts next Monday, March 3rd!

I'm happy to share that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378710/Placebo_Love/]Placebo Love[/url], by me, the creator of [b]Last Word[/b], will be part of the festival with it's largest discount yet, a whopping 80% off!

[h2]Spread the Word!
[/h2]
Please [b]Wishlist [/b]Placebo Love and spread the word! If you know of place where people enjoy sharing and talking about Visual Novels, let them know!

[h2]Summary[/h2]

Placebo Love is a supernatural mystery about a man who has fallen in love with doppelganger soulmates. You are his Muse. Choose his schedule to guide him towards the truth about love, inspiration, and an evil soda company!

Thanks, everyone! Look forward to next week, there will be a lot of cool games on sale!

notes.title: PLACEBO LOVE - New Game by Creator of Last Word!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8566909/08cba02b0ba16bd19d3a691376816b650e1a8e12.png[/img]

Hey there, Lonely Lovers...

[b]Placebo Love[/b] is now available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378710/Placebo_Love/]Steam[/url]!

It's a new game by Twelve Tiles/Merlandese, and it's about [b]Soulmates [/b]and [b]Doppelgangers [/b] and [b]evil Beverage Conglomerates[/b]! And it plays like the "dating sim" sections of a [i]Persona [/i]game! You'll love it!

You see, Lorne Volley answers a spam email promising him the love of his life... but he answers it twice! And despite all odds, he meets his Perfect Woman alright... but also twice! Same face, same laugh, same attitude, but with different names and in different cities! What sort of mysterious conundrum IS this!?

Luckily he has [i]you [/i]to guide him. You're his [b]muse[/b]! You help him make decisions, determine his schedule, and let him know when it's [u]okay to lie[/u]. 

Maybe this game will help you find your Soulmate, and maybe it won't... but what do you have to lose? ;)

Thanks everyone for the help and support in this new endeavor, I hope you love it as much as I do!

- Lan

notes.title: Virgo VS The Zodiac at BitSummit 7 Spirits this weekend!
notes.content:
A big hello to all the Degica fans out there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/7047f9a1426919c77856fd8e95014b89e8176c8b.jpg[/img]

We here at Degica Games are proud to announce our publishing partnership with Moonana the team behind the unforgiving timed action turn-based JRPG Virgo Vs The Zodiac! (VVTZ for short!)

Get ready to "Embark on a cosmic quest to follow your fate, or defy your destiny" this Autumn 2019.

Along with the news of our publishing partnership, Degica and Moonana will be attending Japan's largest Indie Game event, [url=https://bitsummit.org/en/][b]BitSummit 7 Spirits[/b][/url], from June 1st & 2nd at Miyako Messe in Kyoto. If you are in Kyoto come on by and check out the special Virgo Vs The Zodiac demo we will have on display and meet the Moonana team!

[h1]About Virgo VS The Zodiac:[/h1]
[b]Virgo Vs The Zodiac is a sci-fi/fantasy JRPG inspired by the Mario & Luigi RPG series and the Mother RPG series[/b] in which you play as an obsessed villain. The game features traditional turn-based combat with real-time execution of moves: blocking, countering and timing your attacks carefully as well as predicting your foes' moves is essential to succeed in [b]Virgo's twisted and unforgiving cosmic quest to bring back the Golden Age[/b], a period of peace, symmetry and balance, or so she thinks. In this galaxy where every action means a reaction, you’ll play as Virgo, the Holy Queen, often called Dreadful Queen by heretics, bringing mayhem to the Zodiac Realms and leaving a trail of stardust on the way, all to fit her excessively righteous worldview. 

[h1]Special Origins Interview:[/h1]
You can also get a glimpse into the beginnings of the game and how it came to be in this special interview article with the creator Nana.

http://blog.rpgmakerweb.com/interview/virgo-vs-the-zodiac/

[h1]BitSummit 7 Spirits[/h1]
Those who attend the event will be able to try out the exciting battle demo in either English or Japanese!
Attendees who have tried the demo will receive a random acrylic keychain of a character from Virgo Vs The Zodiac! 

For those who come to see us at our booth, we will be also handing out Steam keys for the BitSummit demo version, along with an original designed clear file! 
Supplies are limited so be sure to stop by!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/7fc0cfd37e8fea1c5b946f78ccbc986c997541a7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/01d7ba0480edf3f01a920ae04a502f8d75b11bc0.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Event Info[/h1]
We will be attending as "Degica Games"
Event Name：BitSummit 7 Spirits
Date：June 1st - June 2nd, 2019 
Time：10:00 ～ 17:00 
Venue：Kyoto International Exhibition Hall: MIYAKO MESSE 3rd Exhibition Hall, 3rd Floor
Organizer：BitSummit Organization Committee
[url=http://bitsummit.org/ ]BitSummit Homepage[/url]
We will announce our booth information on the[url=https://twitter.com/degicagames]DegicaGames Official[/url] Twitter account so give us a follow and stay tuned!

notes.title: Previous Twelve Tiles Games on Itch.io!
notes.content:
Before [b]Last Word[/b] bubbled up into our lives like a sparkling melon wine, a few other Twelve Tiles games were already crawling about like beautiful toddlers.

[b]Fleuret Blanc[/b] is a mystery in the style of a Virtual Novel mixed with light JRPG fights. The mystery is longer and richer than Last Word's, but you can clearly see what Last Word did to improve on some of the systems. Despite being a bit rougher around the edges, the plot and character interaction is truly worthy.

[b]Social Caterpillar[/b] is a puzzle game that explores the mechanics of social interacting from the perspective of an introvert who wants desperately to make life easier. It's abstract, it's complex, and it's good.

Both of these games can be downloaded for FREE on Itch.io, so... check 'em out if that's what you're into! Thanks!

[url=https://merlandese.itch.io/]Here's the LINK![/url]

notes.title: New Game+ Added
notes.content:
This update has quite a few things, but the biggest addition is the New Game+ feature! Find the full patch notes below.

[h1]7-6-2016 PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*]NEW GAME+!
[*]Seymour's head is no longer visible in the intro
[*]Key Topic pegs (SHIFT) are appropriately blocked
[*]Added the word "SAVE" to save points
[*]Reduced Seymour's difficulty at low levels
[*]Corrected a bug that hinders loading early files
[*]Some extra dialogues in Gossip (Domestic Feline and Wine Tasting)
[*]Fixed lingering images of Whitty in the ending sequence
[*]Did a little audio changing
[*]Allowed to skip another scene in the final ending
[*]Added names to the Key Topic switcher
[*]Terrible "Immunity Ending" where Whitty just leaves
[*]Expression Accession now grays out if you can't afford it (bug)
[*]Fixed minor error in Upgrades where completion icon doesn't appear (bug)
[*]Allowed several Guest scenes to be skippable
[*]Adjusted command box sizes in Discourse
[*]Adjusted terms when using the Last Word
[*]Made it so that defeating Prattle at the start of the game accomplishes the normal Discourse goal
[*]Reorganized Save Point information
[*]Added TEXT DISPLAY option at Save Point
[*]Added Ancurio to the credits for porting
[*]Altered Whitty's Discourse effects with the best ability
[*]Changed the final scene's variable identifiers
[*]Modified "Dissertation"
[*]Added extra minor scenes to NG+
[/list]

notes.title: 6/24/2015 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Added an indicator when changing Key Topics to denote guest/gossip correlations
-Art call discrepency
-Added Pause image

A BIG change in this one. 

When you scroll through the Key Topics you can now see who has been spoken to by a colored icon. No longer must you click people randomly, fingers crossed, hoping you have not gossiped with them yet!

This should streamline one of the processes that seemed to create a lot of frustration, and I'm pretty happy about it. :)

-Merlandese
